_comment: Cascade spectacle (#187), read by screen code only. A heat tier is on once the cascade has lit minNodes dominoes or a cap of at least minCap (its value per trigger, from the capFired event) has gone off; the last tier on sets the colour and how many sparks trail each flow. While building, the same tiers read the board's node count and the biggest charge on an open end. Tier colours are 0xRRGGBB strings.

seatColours.comment: One colour per seat, by seat order. Chosen to differ from each other, from the six spark colours and from the gold turn highlight.

comfort.comment: Defaults for the menu comfort settings.

fx.comment: Code-drawn fallbacks for the effect textures (fx/<id>). glow and ring are always code-drawn.

projectiles.comment: Effects that fly from a cap to their target (#189). A shot is one trigger of a cap. At most maxOnScreen shots of each kind are in the air at once; further triggers fold into the newest shot of that kind (its x-count and size grow). A shot uses the last tier whose minValue it reaches: size in pixels, travelMs at 1x (bigger is faster), gain (impact loudness 0..1). Colours are 0xRRGGBB strings; sizes are pixels unless a factor of the tier size.
